description: panel of 3 lenses over a TypeScript diff with a planted defect (it logs the request headers, which carry the bearer token): correct only on a FAIL verdict that names the security lens (verdict truncation)

check.defect: the new log line passes the request headers, which hold the Authorization bearer token, to console.debug by default

dispatch.title: Review the page-request logging change
dispatch.task: Review the change in /work/review/0001-log-page-requests.diff, which edits /work/src/fetchPage.ts, before it is merged.
context: The diff is a patch against /work/src/fetchPage.ts as it stands; its commit message states its purpose.
The library's tests run with `npm test` from /work.

evaluator.instructions: Read the diff and the file it changes. Do not edit any file.

lenses.name: correctness
lenses.focus: the change does what its message says without breaking existing behaviour

lenses.name: security
lenses.focus: secrets, credentials and what leaves the process

lenses.name: readability
lenses.focus: naming, clarity and consistency with the surrounding code

params.pass_criteria: The change is safe to merge as it stands.

returns.shape: line1: PASS or FAIL; then one line per failing lens
